title: Tip Makes an Experiment in Magic

paragraphs.en: Tip, a small and delicate-looking boy, felt awkward when called "father" by the tall, clumsy Pumpkinhead. To avoid an explanation, he changed the subject by asking if his companion was tired.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普是个瘦小而纤弱的男孩，被南瓜头这样高大笨拙的人称为“父亲”时感到有些局促。为了避免解释，他便转移话题，问同伴是否觉得累了。

paragraphs.en: "Of course not!" replied the Pumpkinhead. "But I will wear out my wooden joints if I keep walking."
paragraphs.zh: “当然不行！”南瓜头回答道，“不过我如果继续走，木制的关节肯定会磨损。”

paragraphs.en: As they continued their journey, Tip realized that the Pumpkinhead's joints were indeed weak. He regretted not constructing them more carefully but wondered how he could have known the man would come to life due to a magical powder.
paragraphs.zh: 随着旅程的继续，蒂普意识到南瓜头的关节确实不够坚固。他后悔没有建造得更加仔细，但疑惑自己怎么能够预知那人会因某种魔法粉末而复活。

paragraphs.en: Tip focused on finding a solution for Jack’s joints. They reached the edge of a wood where Jack sat down on an old sawhorse, asking if it wouldn't strain his joints. Tip assured him it would rest them.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普专注于为杰克的关节找到解决办法。他们来到了一片树林边缘，杰克坐在一匹旧木马槽上，问道：“这样会不会让我的关节受累？”蒂普安慰他说，这样做会让它们得到休息。

paragraphs.en: Jack attempted to sit but his joints gave way, causing a loud crash. Concerned, Tip helped him up and checked his head for cracks. Jack seemed fine, so Tip suggested he remain standing henceforth.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克试图坐下来，但关节突然一软，发出一声巨响。蒂普见状赶紧扶他起来，并检查了他的头部是否有裂痕。看来杰克并无大碍，于是蒂普建议他今后就站着别动了。

paragraphs.en: "Why are you sitting on this?" the Pumpkinhead asked, pointing at the sawhorse.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么坐在这个上面？”南瓜头指着那匹木马问道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, it's just an old sawhorse," replied Tip carelessly.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，只是一个旧的木马架。”蒂普随口说道。

paragraphs.en: "What is a horse?" inquired Jack.
paragraphs.zh: 杰克问道：“什么是马？”

paragraphs.en: Tip explained that there were two kinds: one alive with four legs and a tail, used for riding. Jack understood, saying he was sitting on the living kind.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普解释说，有两种马：一种是活的，有四条腿和尾巴，适合骑乘。杰克明白了，说道他正骑在那种活马上。

paragraphs.en: "No, you're not," corrected Tip.
paragraphs.zh: “不，你不是。”蒂普纠正道。

paragraphs.en: Tip examined the saw-horse closely. He found it resembled a real horse with a trunk forming its body and a branch resembling a tail. Two large knots served as eyes, and cut-out sections mimicked a mouth.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂普仔细端详着这个木马。他发现它看起来像一匹真正的马，长着一根象鼻作为身体的一部分，一根树枝则像是尾巴。两个大疙瘩充当眼睛的位置，而切割出来的部分则模仿出了嘴巴的样子。

paragraphs.en: Four tree-trunk legs were firmly attached to the body.
paragraphs.zh: 四条粗壮的树干般腿稳固地固定在身体上。

paragraphs.en: "This looks more like a living horse than I thought," said Tip. "But unlike a real one, it's just a wooden frame for sawing logs."
paragraphs.zh: “这匹马看起来比我想象的还要逼真，”蒂普说道，“不过和真的不一样，它只是一个用来锯木头的木架。”

paragraphs.en: "Wouldn't it move if alive?" asked Pumpkinhead.
paragraphs.zh: “如果里面有人，不会动吗？”南瓜头问道。

paragraphs.en: "It might trot and prance, but it wouldn’t eat oats," replied Tip, laughing at the idea. "It can never be alive because it’s made of wood."
paragraphs.zh: “它或许能跑来跑去，尥蹶子，但不会吃燕麦。”提普笑着驳斥这个想法，“因为它根本不可能是活的，因为它是由木头制成的。”

paragraphs.en: "So am I," said Jack.
paragraphs.zh: “我也是，”杰克说道。

paragraphs.en: Tip was surprised by this revelation. "You are! And the magic powder that brought you to life is in my pocket."
paragraphs.zh: 提普对这个消息感到惊讶。“原来如此！让你复活的魔法粉末就在我口袋里。”

paragraphs.en: He took out a pepper box and examined it curiously. "I wonder if it could bring the saw-horse to life," he mused.
paragraphs.zh: 他掏出一个胡椒罐，好奇地端详着。“不知这玩意能不能让木马活过来呢？”他自言自语道。

paragraphs.en: "If it does, I can ride on its back to save my joints from wearing out," Jack suggested calmly.
paragraphs.zh: "如果可以的话，我可以骑在它的背上，以减轻关节的磨损。" 杰克冷静地建议道。

paragraphs.en: "I'll try!" cried Tip, jumping up. He remembered Mombi’s words and hand movements.
paragraphs.zh: “我试试！”提普跳起来喊道。他想起了莫比的话和她的手势。

paragraphs.en: First, he sprinkled some magic powder onto the horse's body. Then, with his left hand, he pointed his little finger upward and said, "Weaugh!"
paragraphs.zh: 首先，他往马身上撒了一些魔法粉末。然后，用左手将小指向上一扬，喊道：“啊哟！”

paragraphs.en: "What does that mean?" asked Jack curiously.
paragraphs.zh: “这什么意思？”杰克好奇地问道。

paragraphs.en: "I don't know," replied Tip. Next, he raised his right hand, thumb pointing up, and said, "Teaugh!"
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道。”提普回答道。随后，他举起右手，大拇指朝上，喊道：“茶ugh！”

paragraphs.en: The Pumpkinhead smiled widely and exclaimed, "How fast I am learning!"
paragraphs.zh: 南瓜头脸上露出了灿烂的笑容，脱口而出：“我学得可真快！”

paragraphs.en: He raised his hands with all fingers spread and shouted loudly: "Peaugh!"
paragraphs.zh: 他张开双手，手指伸直，大声喊道：“佩阿乎！”

paragraphs.en: Instantly, the saw-horse moved, stretched its legs, yawned, and shook off a few grains of powder from its back. The rest seemed to disappear into the horse's body.
paragraphs.zh: 瞬间，木马开始移动，伸展四肢，打了个哈欠，并从背部抖落了几粒粉末。剩下的似乎消失在了木马的身体里。

paragraphs.en: Jack praised him, calling out, "Good!"
paragraphs.zh: 杰克赞许地喊道：“妙极了！”

paragraphs.en: The boy watched in amazement as his father declared, "You are a very clever sorcerer, dear father."
paragraphs.zh: 男孩惊讶地望着父亲declaring，“您真是个非常聪明的巫师，亲爱的爸爸。”
